user.title: LISA Scheduler
user.description: Set up the event scheduler. It fires Home Assistant events when your club's schedule starts and ends, so your automations can trigger actions such as lighting, notifications, screens, heating, or scripts.

data.pre_event_triggers: Pre-event trigger times in minutes (comma-separated, e.g. 120, 30)
data.pre_first_event_triggers: Minutes before first event of day (comma-separated, optional)
data.pre_last_event_end_triggers: Minutes before last event ends (comma-separated, optional)
data.post_last_event_triggers: Minutes after last event ends (comma-separated, optional)
data.dry_run: Dry run mode (log only, don't fire events)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Schedule API
reconfigure.description: Change the lisa-schedule-api endpoint used by this scheduler.

refresh_schedule.name: Refresh Schedule
refresh_schedule.description: Reread the latest event snapshot from the configured schedule API.

enable.name: Enable Scheduler
enable.description: Enable the scheduler so it fires events.

disable.name: Disable Scheduler
disable.description: Disable the scheduler. No events will be fired while disabled.

set_override.name: Set Override
set_override.description: Manually activate the window for a given time period, firing the normal window/event HA events.

start_time.name: Start Time
start_time.description: When to start the override window (ISO format)

end_time.name: End Time
end_time.description: When to end the override window (ISO format)

clear_override.name: Clear Override
clear_override.description: Clear any manual override and resume normal scheduling.
